## Antibody Property Prediction

Antibody Property Prediction

Exact job name: `Antibody_Prediction`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dataPath` | string | yes | file | S3 path to CSV (upload first) |
| `scheme` | string | no / mode-dependent | value | Conditionally required: numbering scheme (e.g. imgt/kabat/chothia) when property_name includes CDR_Prediction |
| `property_name` | array | yes | value | One or more exact backend property identifiers |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "dataPath": {
      "description": "S3 path to CSV (upload first)",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "file"
    },
    "scheme": {
      "description": "Conditionally required: numbering scheme (e.g. imgt/kabat/chothia) when property_name includes CDR_Prediction",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "property_name": {
      "description": "One or more exact backend property identifiers",
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "enum": [
          "Thermal_Stability_Protbert",
          "Thermal_Stability_ESM",
          "Solubility_ESM",
          "CDR_Prediction"
        ],
        "type": "string"
      },
      "x-input-kind": "value",
      "minItems": 1
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "dataPath",
    "property_name"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": true,
  "if": {
    "$comment": "A selection contains CDR_Prediction when not every item excludes it. Uses the validator's existing JSON Schema keywords.",
    "required": [
      "property_name"
    ],
    "properties": {
      "property_name": {
        "type": "array",
        "not": {
          "items": {
            "not": {
              "const": "CDR_Prediction"
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "then": {
    "required": [
      "scheme"
    ]
  }
}
```

## Kinetic Kcat

Predict enzyme kcat or Km values from sequence-substrate pairs.

Exact job name: `kcat_km`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input_path` | string | yes | file | Uploaded CSV with exact case-sensitive seq_id, Sequences and smiles headers. The 2026-10-29 request was accepted but worker validation failed on a missing run label, not a reported CSV-header error. |
| `job_name` | string | no / mode-dependent | value | Worker run label, not the routing name kcat_km. Omit to use the confirmed experiment_name automatically. Explicit values must be 1-100 characters; invalid values are not replaced. |
| `prediction_type` | string | yes | value | values: `kcat, km` |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

## Vaccines

Screen peptide sequences for vaccine-related antigenicity, allergenicity, and toxicity.

Exact job name: `Vaccines`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dataPath` | string | yes | file | Uploaded CSV containing an exact case-sensitive Sequences column, matching the reported server error. Positive submission with this header has not yet been verified by these tests. |
| `property_name` | array | yes | value | Any of `Allergenicity`, `Antigenicity`, `Toxicity`, `Epitope` |
